village.name: Village Square
village.description: A bustling market square filled with vendors and townsfolk.

tower.name: Ancient Tower
tower.description: An imposing tower surrounded by thicklings, its door locked by an ancient key.
tower.image_prompt: dark stone tower gates, fantasy art

potion.name: Magic Potion
potion.description: A bottle filled with glowing blue liquid that grants temporary invincibility.

key.name: Ancient Brass Key
key.description: An old brass key designed to open the door of the ancient tower.

hero.name: Alden
hero.description: A brave apprentice searcher of lost relics.

merchant.name: Garrick the Merchant
merchant.description: A merchant who holds the tower key and can grant a magic potion in exchange for it.

dialogues.before_talk: Garrick: Bring me a potion and I will give you the key to the forbidden tower!
dialogues.after_talk: Garrick: Still looking for the magic potion? Go to the tavern.
dialogues.after_satisfied: Garrick: Wonderful! Here is your magic potion. Use it wisely!
